name: Canonical model reader
responsibility: Explores recursive module scopes and their connections
description: Reads one coherent canonical model and its selected state. Opening a module changes attention without copying architecture. Unmigrated vaults expose explicit migration guidance. Exact retained originals use their captured viewer. A branch reading is keyed by its ref, follows no live change, and offers no claims, code findings or Explain, because each of them reads the vault on disk.
